tests.name: JUnit Console 1.11.4 Link package and CompanionModelTest

implemented: OkHttp 5.5 is the single Android Link transport owner; fresh pairing and restore replace the live wire only after the replacement client is ready.
Pair and unary calls register their OkHttp Call before blocking I/O, remain cancellable, and never execute blocking network work on the Main dispatcher.
Streaming uses rendezvous delivery, cancels the producer when the consumer closes, and awaits call, reader, collector, response, source, and dispatcher quiescence.
closeAndAwait and replaceAndAwait make model replacement and process teardown wait for the prior transport generation.
TLS accepts only the configured leaf SPKI pin; the wrong-pin path reaches no application handler bytes.

The native acceptance driver uses the shared 13-step corpus, validates its isolated DSH_HOME evidence path without following link-shaped parents, and binds terminal events to the current turn and sequence.
acceptance: The real Host acceptance harness, Kotlin driver, shared corpus, and Android workflow are present, but this host did not execute that native lane.
knownLimitations: Earlier direct compiler and JUnit runs used an uncommitted implementation tree without retained reproducible command evidence, so this file does not count them. The exact commands will be recorded only after a clean-source rerun.
The Windows host has JDK 17 but no Gradle or Android SDK, so the official Gradle test lane, app assembly, and real Host-to-Kotlin lane were not executed.
Direct kotlinc and focused JUnit execution do not substitute for Gradle metadata resolution, Android app assembly, or the E4 native Host lane.
